# A COSY CHRISTMAS AT THE MUSEUM

There is plenty to see and do at Designmuseum Danmark in December. You can view this year’s Christmas table by Skov Studio, make wooden Christmas decorations with the family, explore two newly opened exhibitions and take a break in the café with the flavours of the season.

[Read more ](https://designmuseum.dk/en/a-festive-christmas-at-the-design-museum/)

[A COSY CHRISTMAS AT THE MUSEUM link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/a-festive-christmas-at-the-design-museum/ "A COSY CHRISTMAS AT THE MUSEUM link")

September 18 2026 — February 21 2027

# Henrik Vibskov: The Exhibition

This major exhibition focuses on Vibskov’s special way of working and features a wealth of different works and experiences – from tiny models of installations and 44 display cases with objects, prototypes and works from Vibskov’s studio to large-scale installations that visitors can move through.

[Read more ](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/henrik-vibskov/)

[Henrik Vibskov: The Exhibition link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/henrik-vibskov/ "Henrik Vibskov: The Exhibition link")

NEW EXHIBITION ABOUT DANISH DESIGN

# DANISH MODERN

Danish design is known and loved – both at home and abroad. But what led to its success, which designs are central, and who are the major Danish designers of the 20th century? The exhibition 'Danish Modern' unfolds the story of Danish design from the 1920s to the 1970s, focusing on the creation of some of the most iconic Danish design objects.

[Read more ](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/danish-modern/)

[DANISH MODERN link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/danish-modern/ "DANISH MODERN link")

# EXPERIENCE VERNER PANTON CLASSICS

To mark the 100th anniversary of Verner Panton, Designmuseum Danmark is showcasing some of the most iconic furniture pieces by the celebrated designer. As the 3daysofdesign festival kicks off on 10 June, the museum opens a true Panton universe for visitors to explore throughout the rest of the year.

[Read more ](https://designmuseum.dk/en/verner-panton-100-years/)
